meta.title: Loading Factors: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan.
Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify that Loading Factors is refused or absent.
Repeat the Loading Factors action as a Buyer and verify that it is available.
Compare the non-Buyer and Buyer outcomes on the same tenant.
